title: Micro Output Ledger — Weekly KPI & Intent Notes
content:
Weekly snapshot (one line): ship minimal token-cache healthchecks and push a tiny cost-reduction experiment; keep latency P95 below 120ms for fast routes.

Why this week (context):
- Quiet week on infra churn; good moment to carve 3 micro wins that compound.
- Product asked for a cheap fallback that doesn't degrade UX. idea: small quantized variant with prefix-cache warming.

Micro-OKR (working draft):
O: Reduce inference unit cost friction on small, latency-sensitive routes while retaining model quality.
KR1: Reduce cost-per-1k-tokens on selected route by 8% (baseline: 0.72 USD/1k) by end of week 2.
KR2: Keep P95 generation latency for that route under 120ms (current: ~142ms).
KR3: Add a lightweight healthcheck and KV-cache warmup to reduce first-token tail by 30%.

Metrics I will track (quick table):
- route: chat-short (policy=low-latency)
  - baseline cost/1k: 0.72 USD -> target 0.66 USD
  - p95 latency: 142ms -> target <120ms
  - first-token tail(95th): 180ms -> target 126ms
- daily deploys tested: 3 (canary, canary+warm, full)

Hypotheses & experiments (small, numbered):
1) quantize-8bit + prefix-kv-cache warmup reduces amortized cost without affecting top-1 token match for short prompts (~<128 tokens).
   - experiment plan: run A/B on 5k requests from synthetic promptset, compare token-level perplexity proxy and human-eval subset.
   - quick pass metrics: token-match delta, avg tokens/req, latency P95.
2) route-level batching at 20ms window will reduce unit cost but could push p95 > target; use adaptive window if p95 increases.
   - fallback: auto-route to hosted-variant when p95 breach >150ms for 5m.

Retros (last 2 weeks, bullets):
- Good: trimmed a bunch of unused model artifacts; reduced image size of model bundle by 10%.
- Meh: rollout cadence got noisy; missed one canary because of flaky infra test.
- Learn: add a tiny preflight smoke for canary (one short prompt).

Personal weekly rituals (compact):
- Monday morning: 15min metric triage (cost, p95, error rate).
- Wednesday: 30min experiment sync with Maya.
- Friday: 20min write-up + link to GH/JIRA; pause for next-week goals.

Open questions / notes to self (TODOs):
- [ ] Decide threshold for adaptive batching: start at 12ms window? try 8/12/20ms.
- [ ] Prep promptset: pick 200 representative short prompts from product logs (ask CS for redacted sample).
- [ ] Add conservative fallback mapping in rollout policy: (chat-short -> hosted-fast if p95>150ms for 5m).
- [ ] Measure quality drift: pick 100 responses to check hallucination/regression.

Micro blockers:
- access to redacted product logs (CS needs to sign off) — chasing Rahul.
- small infra test flakiness in gpu-node-12 (filed INF-934).

Decisions to make by EOD Tuesday:
- which quantization profile (q8_4 vs q8_dynamic) to try first (lean q8_dynamic if speed tradeoff looks OK).
- window sizes for micro-batching experiment.

Notes to future me: keep the journal terse. if experiment fails, capture one clear failure reason and a short next action. No long essays here.

Quick link map (for final write-up):
- GH branch: serving-runtime/feature/micro-output-ledger
- PR: GH:serving-runtime/pr/1342 (draft)
- JIRA epic: INF-842 (micro-cost-initiative)

End-of-week checklist (ship):
- [ ] run canary with warmup and quantify cost delta
- [ ] validate p95 on production-sample (synthetic + live sample)
- [ ] create a 1-page note for product with observed perf/quality tradeoffs

Small signature: leo — keep small bets, log the result.
